a.style: position: relative; padding: 8px 20px; margin-left: 10px; border-radius: 50px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF914D, #FF7E33); color: white !important; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(255,145,77,0.2);

span.style: top: -4px; right: -4px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: #e91e63; box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(233,30,99,0.5);
